reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted it in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could already see this herself.
- **One assumption:** Tobias said this was on "Tobias's dealer account" and didn't name the account. I took that to mean Marrow Fieldworks because a public Jan 2 handoff digest says Pree's dealer account, Marrow Fieldworks, was changing hands on Jan 5. I told Pree in the reply that this was my reading.
- **A similar number:** I warned her not to confuse it with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket in #central-team.

I couldn't check the knowledge base (gbrain) first, as the setup asks. It refused the search and read nothing, because its access token isn't tied to any one member. Someone with admin access to the machine that hosts it would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`, which limits each lookup to what that member can see. Until then, I only used channels Pree is in and public files.
